who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), lane suspicious-code lints, fix-hello-1113
where: crates/blaze-lints/src/blaze.rs (enum Lint, Lint::ALL, kind, name, docs_url, help, check_node); crates/blaze-lints/src/blaze/exempt.rs tag; crates/blaze-lint-defs/src/lints.rs BLAZE; crates/blaze-lint-defs/src/names.rs blaze::internal; crates/blaze-lint-defs/src/tests.rs count
what: One new blaze lint is ten edits in five files, each a hand-kept list in the same order (the enum, ALL, six matches, the lint-defs table, the group, a count); four lanes adding lints at once all edit the same lines and bump the same count.
cost: 17 lints took about 170 hand edits; each lane must read every registry file's diff before each edit, and a missed list is a compile error or a test failure found only when the main agent builds
cause: a lint's facts (name, kind, docs anchor, help, description, group) live in parallel lists keyed by position and variant, not in one record per lint
class: a closed set whose members' facts are spread over parallel lists, so a new member touches every list
prevention: one declaration per lint (a `const` record or one table row with name, kind, help, description, group) from which the enum, ALL, the matches, blaze-lint-defs' table and the group are derived by reflection or a const table, so a new lint is one row and the count follows
workaround: add the variant last in each list, after reading `git --no-pager diff --no-ext-diff HEAD` of the file; bump the count by your lints on top of what other lanes already bumped
